column1: # ACTION TB (p230) - the LAZY-QUANTIFIER lint. LIMB 1 FIRES at 2.
# The test is mechanical: expand the quantified character class and the terminator
# lookahead class and INTERSECT them. A non-empty intersection means the instrument can
# stop inside its own subject. An empty one means a lazy quantifier that is perfectly safe,
# which most of the 51 in compose/code are - a grep for `*?` is NOT this lint.
# Positive control: p228's SLUG_RE, overlap {'.'} - FLAGGED.
# Negative control: p230's own greedy harvest.py SLUG_RE - NOT flagged.
# Sweep: 326 instrument directories, every *.py outside fixtures/.
